prompts.name: pale-oak
prompts.prompt: Generate a seamless square physically based BASE COLOR texture only, orthographic straight-on scan of beautiful pale natural white oak cabinetry veneer. Fine restrained predominantly straight vertical grain, no plank joins, no handles, no objects. Warm light beige honey-free oak, like refined Scandinavian pale oak, subtle pores and very gentle growth-ring variation. Flat neutral illumination with no shading, shadows, highlights, vignette or perspective. Tile seamlessly at all four edges. No text, border or watermark. 1024 by 1024 texture asset.
